Class TamperingAssessment

java.lang.Object
imageproof.TamperingAssessment
public final class TamperingAssessment extends Object
Final assessment of ONE image. This is the last analysis step before App shows the result.

It combines three kinds of evidence:

  • the local anomaly rule (LocalAnomaly): regional histogram, noise and edge measurements that agree in the same place,
  • the solid-colour patch rule (FlatPatch),
  • the exact copy-move detector (CopyMove).

There are three outcomes:

  • TamperingAssessment.Outcome.POSSIBLE_TAMPERING: at least one rule found something (flagged tiles, a verified copy pair group, or a solid patch).
  • TamperingAssessment.Outcome.INCONCLUSIVE: the measurements are invalid, the local rule could not run, or the copy search was not conclusive.
  • TamperingAssessment.Outcome.NO_CLEAR_INDICATORS: nothing was found. This does NOT prove that the image is original, unedited or authentic.

The anomalous-area percentage (areaPercent) is a MEASURED AREA: 100 * flagged pixel area / analyzed pixel area. It is never a probability of forgery or editing.

This is a teaching tool. It is not forensic proof.
